status.description: How the STAGE went, never what it concluded about the feature. OK: the stage ran and produced its artifact — this includes a verify that rejects, because reaching a rejection is a verify that worked. FAILED: the stage could not produce its artifact. NEEDS_HUMAN: a person has to look before anything else happens.

message.description: One line on what happened, at most 500 characters. Longer is trimmed.

verdict.description: The judgement on the feature, and the only place a rejection belongs. Required on verify; NONE everywhere else, which is the only value allowed there. REJECTED here with status OK is what opens the bounded fix loop.
